basic_info.description: 3044 California Street is a sophisticated fusion of timeless elegance and modern luxury, nestled in the prestigious Pacific Heights neighborhood and just steps away from the shops and boutiques of Laurel Village and Sacramento Street in Presidio Heights. Reimagined in 2018, this four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom Tenancy in Common residence offers an exquisite balance of historic charm and contemporary living. Bathed in natural light and adorned with soaring ceilings, every space invites a sense of grandeur while maintaining an intimate atmosphere. At the heart of the home, the expansive main living area seamlessly integrates the kitchen, dining, and living spacesan entertainer's dream, framed by southern exposure. The chef's kitchen, outfitted with state-of-the-art Viking appliances, is designed for culinary excellence and refined gatherings.
